rites.name: Millenia
rites.text: A tightening of the body into a protective ball that raises a creature's shielding against harm. It is a move of the defensive kind, first known in the earliest age of the world.

rites.name: Ristes Cestes
rites.text: A ground-based technique that lets a creature burrow beneath the surface. Users learn it through a teaching disc passed along between generations of trainers.

rites.name: Alairora
rites.text: Alairora is a concept of the Breraston powers, a notion of a hymn that stitches loose ground into the first roots of the world during the Singing. In the Age of Strangers, traders learned to borrow its pull to anchor their boats to drifting shores. It is remembered less as a force than as a way of bargaining with the sea.

rites.name: Orausium
rites.text: A forceful strike in which a bundle of hurled seed-pods batters a foe. It is the signature technique of a clustered grove-creature and its towering grown form.

rites.name: Cesauntia
rites.text: A slow-gathering technique in which a bearer stores strain for a while before releasing it in a single blow. It is taught through a sealed teaching-stone, which passes the method to a new student.

rites.name: Vianostum
rites.text: A returning strike that answers a blow with a blow. It carries a fighting-type character and was once sold as a teaching stone in an early age.

rites.name: Serellum
rites.text: A ground-aligned strike technique that hurls a bone-like missile which strikes twice before returning. It belongs to the signature techniques of a small horned creature line.

rites.name: Amorernia
rites.text: A chilling gust of frozen air that a creature can unleash to strike foes. It is taught through a numbered disc so that trainers may pass it along to their companions.

rites.name: Valostaulum
rites.text: A dense ball of marsh sludge is hurled at an opponent, wiping away every bonus or penalty that has built up on them. It leaves their strengths and weaknesses as they were before.

rites.name: Rialanum Ciseornia
rites.text: A ground-shaking technique that a creature can learn from a sealed disc. Its tremors strike all nearby foes at once.

rites.name: Vonia
rites.text: A harmless technique of an early age that deals no injury. It is taught to the old practitioners of the craft and passed down since the first days of the realm.

rites.name: Callisus
rites.text: A simple technique that a creature can use to slice through obstacles blocking its path. It is taught as a standard skill passed between wanderers.

rites.name: Cilesia
rites.text: A quiet, harmless practice in which a creature draws strength from the earth beneath it. It renews the user's vitality bit by bit each turn.

rites.name: Serirnollus
rites.text: A dormant inner strength that some creatures carry, letting them strike with far greater force than their frame would suggest. Only a handful of beings are known to hold it.

rites.name: Rolor
rites.text: A practiced hand-edge blow that a fighter delivers to strike an opponent. Early teachers long taught it as a disciplined combat craft, and it is counted among the forms of close struggle.

rites.name: Tentum
rites.text: A ground-shaking technique that a guardian beast of the old wilds unleashes against foes. It is said to be a signature power of that creature.

rites.name: Seraullus
rites.text: A tide-born technique that hurls churning silt and brackish sludge at foes. It was once the signature art of a pair of marsh-dwelling amphibious creatures.

rites.name: Melia
rites.text: A gift that lets its bearer draw a passing storm-strike toward themselves and absorb it harmlessly. Many creatures carry this inheritance, and a few bear it in altered forms.

rites.name: Valornes Costiarnus
rites.text: A dark-aligned technique that a spectral creature line once used as its hallmark. It is taught as a machine-stamped scroll in later eras.

rites.name: Orania Vintia
rites.text: A spiny strike of living barbs, drawn from prickly desert growths. It was once the favored technique of a pair of thorn-bearing kin, and a few related cactus-folk still know it.

rites.name: Meostiares
rites.text: A ranged technique where a fighter flings wet earth and grit at a rival to strike them. It can also slow the target's pace.

rites.name: Oriallium
rites.text: A shielding art that bends an incoming force back toward its source. Apprentices learn it again each time its lost teaching is recovered from old records.

rites.name: Lostum Seriantus
rites.text: A ritual sway that calls down a steady downpour for a short spell. Its wielders learn it as a way to coax the sky into weeping over fields in need.

rites.name: Sianus Canus
rites.text: A defensive technique that a being can use to guard itself for a single turn. It was first taught in a later generation of the realm's training, and is recorded on a numbered scroll whose index has changed over time.

rites.name: Orauneontes
rites.text: A stony barrage that tumbles down onto foes from above. It was taught through a sealed scroll and later rediscovered in a new form.

rites.name: Orintostum
rites.text: A jabbing strike in which the attacker drives a sharp horn or beak into its foe. It is a harmful technique that dates from the earliest known era of the land.

rites.name: Vialia
rites.text: A basic technique in which a creature lashes its opponent with a tail, limb, or body. Many young creatures learn it early in their training.

rites.name: Siluamirlys
rites.text: Siluamirlys is a concept within Breraston's Martial Realm, born in the Courts during the second era of divine trials, councils, and the raising of doors between worlds. It embodies the discipline that makes a contest between powers something decided by measure rather than by ruin.

rites.name: Zephyustora
rites.text: Zephyustora is an abstract concept in Breraston, a Martial-realm idea of the wind that carries trials between the Courts. Its scholars hold that the doors between worlds were first hung on its breath during the Holy Age of flame and temples.

rites.name: Oriares
rites.text: Oriares is the concept of the trial by fire that the orders of Breraston hold to be the true test of any sworn knight. In the Holy Age it is taught in the temples as a discipline of flame, where a bearer learns to hold and release heat as a vow, not a weapon. Its practitioners are said to carry the first sparks of the Courts into the mortal world.

rites.name: Zephezasha
rites.text: Zephezasha is an abstract concept of Breraston, personified in the Courts as the principle of disciplined flame that the orders of the Holy Age learned to kindle and keep. Its temples hold that its strength lies less in any single blaze than in the steady discipline that feeds it across generations.

rites.name: Teraules
rites.text: A caustic, corrosive mist that is hurled at foes to sear them. It is a fluid-based technique that lands on its target.

rites.name: Amonium
rites.text: A craft exclusive to a single bloodline of beings, it is a trap that keeps opponents from escaping a contest once it is set. It was first recorded in the third age of the world.

rites.name: Coreoria
rites.text: A ground-aligned strike technique introduced in the second era of training, once the trademark maneuver of a horned, bone-carrying creature until the fourth era.

rites.name: Taseornes
rites.text: A nightmare-binding craft that torments sleeping foes. It belongs to a shadowy sleeper who wields it as their defining art.

rites.name: Montanum
rites.text: A tutor-taught technique that hurls a stream of sudden foam-bound bubbles at a foe. Those who strike with it leave the target slowed in its movement.

rites.name: Reonium
rites.text: A sealing power that stops the sky's shifting moods from changing around a bearer. It belongs to one great sky-serpent and is its defining gift.

rites.name: Ceontarnus
rites.text: A ranged technique in which a creature hurls a flurry of sharp spines at its foes. It is the trademark strike of two spiny, puffed-up beasts of the marshes.

rites.name: Valauntum
rites.text: A tribal rite in which a warrior's clawed grip is pressed down onto an enemy with punishing force. It was once the signature technique of a fierce hunting beast.

rites.name: Sintaurum
rites.text: A fiery kicking technique belonging to a temple-trained fighter. It is the signature strike of a particular flame-plumed warrior and was taught in the third age of the order.

rites.name: Sarium
rites.text: A heavy throwing strike that crashes the whole body down onto a foe. Students learn it early from a sacred scroll.

rites.name: Nares
rites.text: A quiet inherent gift held only by two marsh-dwelling beings, it cancels the influence of weather upon the land around them. Its effect mirrors that of a wind-bound seal that calms the skies.

rites.name: Corares
rites.text: A charged strike that discharges a surge of lightning upon contact with its target. It is a signature technique of a legendary dragon-beast that wields the thunder of storms.

rites.name: Nesium Nausum
rites.text: A primal force of old that a creature can call upon to strike. Gathering it can also stir certain beings toward a deeper transformation into a stronger form.

rites.name: Sialles
rites.text: A grasping technique passed down by a shell-bearing creature, used by pressing and trapping an opponent in its hard jaws. An old lineage of these creatures once made it their defining art.

rites.name: Telares
rites.text: A close-quarters striking technique belonging to the fighting arts. It was once the defining blow of a sturdy wrestler-warrior line before newer methods replaced it.

rites.name: Valirnia
rites.text: A chameleon-like craft that lets a creature alter its surface coloring to match its surroundings. Only one specific shapeshifting creature is able to perform it.

rites.name: Corosanum
rites.text: A calming, rhythmic discipline that a practitioner invokes to heighten their own physical mass and stance. It belongs to the martial craft of combat disciplines.

rites.name: Miallanum
rites.text: A strike delivered by whipping a watery appendage against a foe. It belongs to a school of attacks that deal harm through force rather than status effects.

rites.name: Telostanum Sarum
rites.text: A quiet inner discipline taught by the temple-keepers, letting a bearer steady their thoughts and sharpen their inner focus. Novices learn it through a numbered scroll passed among the orders.

rites.name: Telostus Saullastor
rites.text: A grappling technique that a single hulking warrior alone can perform. It can end a clash with a wild beast, and in a duel against a rival it forces the opponent's champion to be swapped out for another fighter.

rites.name: Amiastia
rites.text: A charm-craft that stirs a rival creature's affection toward its caster. Students learn it from a teaching stone that is passed between generations of tutors.

rites.name: Ciastenia
rites.text: A gust-wielding technique used by a great sky-spirit to strike its foes. It is the signature strike of that mighty being.

rites.name: Serolium
rites.text: A fighting-style technique that lets a user sense an incoming strike and guard against it for the turn. It is taught to fighters in the training circles of the old orders.

rites.name: Coriallium
rites.text: A sacred strike of divine reckoning, reserved for a single celestial being. It is a rite of a higher order that cannot be turned aside by ordinary wards or lures.

rites.name: Oreonises
rites.text: A rare technique of gem-like shards whirled into a stormy onslaught, passed down as the mark of one singular, luminous creature. It is known only to those who bear the sacred stone's gift.

rites.name: Resium
rites.text: A green life-draining craft in which a wielder pierces a foe with a barbed horn and siphons vitality back into their own body. It was once the hallmark technique of a forest-dwelling beast.

rites.name: Nostium
rites.text: A withering hex that a caster can channel through a rite of sacrifice, sapping strength from a foe. Its wielders once learned it from a sealed scroll and later took it up anew.

rites.name: Seorniallus
rites.text: A mind-based technique introduced in an early era of the craft. It was once the signature method of two forest-dwelling beings until a later age.

rites.name: Taullernia
rites.text: A combatant may break off a clash by slipping away entirely, ending the struggle early. Rivals who are themselves bound by a duel cannot be forced to yield this way.

rites.name: Veoranum Tiarnium
rites.text: A glowing sphere of gathered life-force that is hurled at a foe. It is taught to willing bearers through a sacred disc passed down from earlier generations.

rites.name: Voliastia
rites.text: A coiled, scaled exhale of heated force that a creature releases to strike an opponent. It is taught through a sacred ritual stone known as a numbered tablet.

rites.name: Caurum
rites.text: A ritual sigil taught by a hive-mother to her swarm, drawing her guardians into a shielding formation. It is one of three sacred commands she alone may give.

rites.name: Tolenanum
rites.text: A fixed, unavoidable blast of draconic fury that always wears down a rival by the same set amount. In some lands the same breath strikes harder, carrying a greater toll.

rites.name: Teoria
rites.text: A hidden craft known only to one shapeshifting creature, which lets it copy the form of whatever it meets. The gift belongs to that single being alone and appears only in later ages of the world.

rites.name: Lenanum
rites.text: A dim, rippling surge of hidden force that a practitioner releases from the body to strike an opponent. Its shadowy nature makes it a technique recorded among the later orders of the old craft.

rites.name: Mernus
rites.text: A creeping vine-wrapped staff used as a signature strike by a forest guardian spirit. It is a grass-type technique that lashes foes with woven tendrils.

rites.name: Tiarania
rites.text: A physical striking technique in which the attacker's palm lands two quick blows on the foe. It is a contact art taught from the earliest days of the craft.

rites.name: Valontaures
rites.text: A ground-aligned technique in which a fighter drives a spinning, piercing assault forward into its foe. Practitioners can learn it by studying a sealed scroll of stone-carved wisdom.

rites.name: Mintanum
rites.text: A bond held only by a particular order of guardians, granted to nine chosen beings. It lets them stand firm against threats that would sway others.

rites.name: Millanum Sisernanum
rites.text: A discipline of unbroken attention that many kinds of creatures can learn. It keeps a bearer steady and unmoved by distraction, and it has been practiced across many lineages.

rites.name: Amialontor
rites.text: A spiraling strike technique that brings down its target in a single blow. It was once taught through a sealed scroll recorded in the early orders' archive.

rites.name: Amollum
rites.text: A tide-bound gift that belongs solely to one sea-dwelling being, letting its kin call down soft rain.

rites.name: Telernes
rites.text: A fierce technique in which a creature lashes out with sharp, scaled talons to rend its foe. It is a strike of ancient reptilian power, taught and passed among warriors who revere the wyrm lineage.

rites.name: Serialus Amaurum
rites.text: A ritual technique in which a sorcerer's ghostly lantern-spirit unleashes a dark, binding sphere of shade. It is performed in unison with the sorcerer's bond-partner.

rites.name: Naurnor
rites.text: A reflecting veil that a caster raises to bounce an incoming hostile effect back toward whoever sent it. Certain small hopping spirits are known to wield it as their own signature craft.

rites.name: Vontistus
rites.text: A forceful strike technique that a fighter delivers with a single heavy, crushing blow. It belongs to the older, sturdier style of combat taught among the early practitioners.

rites.name: Colum
rites.text: A ritual sway performed beneath pale night light, traditionally practiced by one revered sky-spirit. Its gentle rhythm is said to soothe and renew those who witness it.

rites.name: Lausium
rites.text: A ritual gift of the temple orders that leaves its bearer's defenses open to every strike. Twelve bearers of the gift are recorded, and three of them have been transformed by a deeper rite.

rites.name: Amentor
rites.text: A borrowed technique that copies the last action an opponent used and repeats it. The copying continues until the user falls or withdraws from the contest.

rites.name: Coreolanor
rites.text: A ritual binding that, for five turns, silences the held trinkets of an opponent so they cannot draw on their charms. It is a clever craft practised in the ancient halls.

rites.name: Meseostia
rites.text: A calm, harmless gesture that a fighter makes toward a rival, causing the opponent's guard to weaken. It leaves no wounds but leaves the foe more open to later blows.

rites.name: Lernus
rites.text: A high-pitched roaring wind technique that belongs to the icy-stone discipline. It is the signature practice of one heavy, frost-backed beast from the northern highlands.

rites.name: Leorus Serenia
rites.text: A slow, quiet healing that creatures gain simply by lingering in wild places where contests of strength occur. Each passing span of time gently knits their wounds closed.

rites.name: Orisanor
rites.text: A fierce strike of pure insect fury, delivered by a creature that has long favored it. It is a technique that was once a champion's chosen art before passing on to other hands.

rites.name: Valeriantia
rites.text: A binding craft that wraps a creature's form in ancient bandaged shrouds, passed only among a few lonely spirit-kin who guard their tombs.

rites.name: Seolanum
rites.text: A quiet inherited knack that certain small lightning-bearing creatures use to bolster a close companion's strength. For a long span of years it marked one particular kind of spirit-kin and no other.

rites.name: Neosalia
rites.text: A fiery technique unleashed in swirling columns of molten rock that trap an opponent. It belongs to a towering molten beast known for wielding it.

rites.name: Virnaustes
rites.text: A stare that fixes a rival in place so it cannot withdraw from the contest. Its binding effect matches that of a simple barrier, and it was first taught to fighters in the second age of the craft.

rites.name: Caustianor
rites.text: A swirling orb of drifting vapor that a sky-dwelling guardian hurls at foes. It is the defining technique of that creature.

rites.name: Caullares
rites.text: A innate knack that draws certain creatures tied to the land's hidden pull. It belongs only to beings that sense and follow that pull.

rites.name: Teleones
rites.text: A ritual flowing movement shared between a green-robed leader and her great blossom beast. The two perform it together to unleash a surge of plant power.

rites.name: Celia
rites.text: A tracking craft that lets a practitioner strike any foe, even one that is hiding or slipping away. It is especially effective against a particular kind of wary target.

rites.name: Orosor
rites.text: A stillness that locks the limbs of anyone it touches, leaving them unable to move. It is a condition that takes hold of a body and holds it fast.

rites.name: Valinanum
rites.text: A forceful dance of scattered blossoms that strikes an opponent over several rounds. The dancer is left dizzy afterward, though those with a steadfast spirit stay clear-headed.

rites.name: Lesaror
rites.text: A dormant inner vitality awakens in certain creatures when their health falls low. Their plant-born energies then flow far stronger than usual.

rites.name: Cellintus
rites.text: A soothing hymn-song that a traveling singer performs to calm even the most furious wild beings. It has been known to quiet two mighty sky-and-sea guardians.

rites.name: Corontia Mirnum
rites.text: A rage-driven striking technique that a pair of wild brawling beasts use as their defining blow. It channels a fighter's fury into a single, heavy punch.

rites.name: Valiarnus
rites.text: A fierce lock of fury that holds the bearer in one unbroken assault until the clash ends. Each blow taken from a rival swells its force, though breaking the chain lets the swell drain away.

rites.name: Raulium
rites.text: A gift passed down through a line of small forest spirits, it lets them heal themselves whenever the sky opens and the rain falls. It was their defining talent until a later age of deeper gifts arrived.

rites.name: Cillestium
rites.text: A swift spinning technique that strikes an opponent with a physical blow. It belongs to the family of cool-type arts first known in the earliest age of the craft.

rites.name: Sirniantes
rites.text: A dried leaf that lets its bearer unleash a charged strike at once, skipping the wind-up. It is consumed after a single use.

rites.name: Mesteollum
rites.text: A furious charging maneuver of the wild beast-kin, unleashed in a sudden surge of blind fury. It is the trademark assault of the great horned herd-lord.

rites.name: Villor
rites.text: A grade of forceful exchange in which harm is dealt by strength of body and the resistance of the struck foe. Its blows travel by direct contact or by solid projectiles, and some are touch-triggered.

rites.name: Menteostor
rites.text: A sacred ability held only by one great sea-beast of the old world. It lets its bearer command the waters and the weather over vast stretches of ocean.

rites.name: Coriasum
rites.text: A sacred power that lets two ancient beasts cast off their later shapes and return to their first, mightiest forms. Each beast must be paired with its own glowing sphere to make the change happen.

rites.name: Mireostum
rites.text: A plain, untyped blow that any fighter can deliver by pressing the attack key while inside a deep delve. It is weak and rarely recommended, and it leaves a fighter with few options once its techniques are spent.

rites.name: Neosia
rites.text: An ancient chant sung by a delicate songbird-like spirit, carrying a graceful, beautiful power. It is the spirit's signature tune, passed down as a cherished rite.

rites.name: Viallaunor
rites.text: A lingering toxic affliction that seeps into a creature and wears at it slowly. A more virulent strain also exists, eating away at the victim far faster.

rites.name: Tiarnum
rites.text: A dormant inner resonance that belongs only to one lineage of small wandering beings. It lets them strike with greater force when they awaken it.

rites.name: Amolanium
rites.text: A restorative art that mends the practitioner's own body, knitting back up to half of their vitality. It works just like two other common healing rites of the same kind.

rites.name: Vonium
rites.text: A gift-giving technique used by a small, round creature that hands out offerings to its allies. Its power is measured in the value of the item presented rather than in harm dealt.

rites.name: Sostinium
rites.text: A venomous strike technique in which a practitioner drives a tainted point into a foe, causing harm and leaving a lingering toxin behind.

rites.name: Amostes
rites.text: An ancient inner power that awakens in certain primeval beings and sharpens their strength when the sun or sky is bright. It mirrors a younger, watery-current twin that flows in their kin.

rites.name: Orialerium
rites.text: A crackling strike used by a companion creature, a signature technique that channels its bond with its partner. It empowers the bearer during battles.

rites.name: Raules Amauntoses
rites.text: A soft, fine frost is conjured into a small storm that chills every rival in its reach. It was first recorded during a later era of the craft.

rites.name: Teontesanum
rites.text: A quiet restorative craft in which a bearer sinks into stillness to mend weary strength. Its lore is passed down through several generations of practitioners who record it on stone tablets.

rites.name: Sostanum
rites.text: A quiet gift that lets a creature's natural force grow stronger when it is fighting. Seventeen beings in this world carry it, and a few of them can transform further.

rites.name: Oriasor
rites.text: A swift strike technique used by a hive-bearing queen, delivered in coordinated bursts. It is one of her three signature techniques.

rites.name: Liarnes
rites.text: A innate inner heat that awakens in creatures of one fiery lineage when they are pressed hard. It lets them unleash stronger flames in their moment of need.

rites.name: Oralanum
rites.text: A gathering craft that swells the force of every strike of its kind. It was first taught to the wandering guilds of the third age.

rites.name: Teornanum
rites.text: A hooking maneuver of the sea-bound, where a creature of the deep lashes out and clamps its foe in place. It is the trademark technique of a single anchor-like being.

rites.name: Valisenes
rites.text: A learned inner knack that certain beings carry from birth, quietly shaping how they meet the world. It first took hold in a later age of the chronicles.

rites.name: Ristes
rites.text: A grim strike of rust-colored resentment that a fierce spirit-blade creature unleashes as its trademark technique. It is used only by that one creature.

rites.name: Sinentium
rites.text: A quiet enchantment carried within a creature's bearing that, when someone strikes it, stirs an infatuation in opposing beings of the opposite kind. It mirrors a lure that draws hearts toward the bearer.

rites.name: Amornaunium
rites.text: A passive stance that lets a bearer remain standing through a blow that would otherwise fell them. It is taught to followers through sealed tokens passed between generations of trainers.

rites.name: Seolia
rites.text: A craft that lets a creature wear a false appearance, shaping how others perceive it. It is practiced only by a single breed of small fox-like beings.

rites.name: Veseonia
rites.text: A fighting-style strike that gathers the energy of a foe into the striker's fist. Its technique was first taught in a scroll-coded training manual.

rites.name: Corollus
rites.text: A coordinated battle technique shared by a rider and their scaled beast, channeling the bond between them into a single fierce strike. It belongs to one fighter and her companion creature.

rites.name: Mianestor
rites.text: A chilling, icy power that a practitioner can unleash as a focused beam. It is taught through a numbered scroll that appears in most of the realm's training traditions, though not in one older lineage.

rites.name: Rirus
rites.text: A ceremonial guardian-technique practiced by a single noble bloodline of armored sentinels. It is the signature art of their chief warden, a shield-bearing spirit.

rites.name: Nolus
rites.text: A coined strike technique in which a fighter turns harm received into a returned blow. It is recognized as a damaging art belonging to the later age of the realm.

rites.name: Riastes
rites.text: A shimmering arcane force drawn from the spirit of still waters, wielded by the sworn wardens of a sacred lake. It is their signature craft, passed down through the guardians who keep the waters safe.

rites.name: Orianalus
rites.text: A short sung charm that shields its speaker from fatal strokes for five turns. Its protective hold can be seized away by a rival's rite.

rites.name: Oraunum
rites.text: A ghostly tea-green technique that a certain creature unleashes to strike its foes. It is the signature strike of its kind, passed down among those who wield it.

rites.name: Amiranum
rites.text: A protective craft found only among one lineage of crystalline beings, shielding them from harm and spreading across their descendants over successive generations.

rites.name: Telianes Nausia
rites.text: A bright strike drawn from a jewel set in a creature's body, channeled as a force of stone. Only a few such stone-born techniques are known to exist.

rites.name: Telantor
rites.text: A green-natured strike that a fighter can unleash. It belongs to a set of nine elemental blows that share the same power.

rites.name: Liastus
rites.text: A bond-tinged strike that grows stronger the more a creature values its keeper. It is a move that answers affection with force.

rites.name: Ceollor Serarnium
rites.text: A fine toxic dust that a creature scatters over an opponent to sicken it. It deals no direct harm and works by leaving the target poisoned.

rites.name: Amornianor
rites.text: A ground-aspected strike that calls down jagged stone spears on the foe. It belongs to a colossal earth titan and is one of its defining attacks.

rites.name: Rintanum
rites.text: A heavy, ground-shaking strike that crushes whatever it lands on. Each impact drags the target's quickness down by a single step.

rites.name: Amalentor
rites.text: A recurring technique of one hardened fighter of a far-off lineage, sharpened and passed down through generations of struggle. It is a practice of relentless striking in which each blow opens the way for the next.

rites.name: Mallor
rites.text: A faculty granted only to one particular kind of creature, shaping how its bearers perceive and act. It was first recorded in a later age of the world.

rites.name: Maunisia
rites.text: A coordinated technique in which a partner pairs with a frost-bearing beast to unleash a sudden, sweeping rush that crashes down on foes. It belongs to a single trainer and her companion creature.

rites.name: Naulanum
rites.text: A charged discharge that surges from a wielder's hands in a focused arc. When it strikes true, it sharpens the caster's inner power a little, and it can be taught through a token earned by defeating a marked champion.

rites.name: Amallor
rites.text: A fiery defensive technique in which a creature shields itself in flame. It is the trademark maneuver of a particular fire-breathing beast.

rites.name: Varnum
rites.text: A soft, buoyant technique that a small companion creature can perform. It wraps the user in a springy film that cushions and rebounds blows.

rites.name: Caurnalia
rites.text: A dark, spiteful technique introduced in a later age, performed by the shadowy fox-kin that claim it as their own signature craft.

rites.name: Siasallum
rites.text: A living gift that belongs only to certain green-blooded creatures. It quickens their movement whenever the sunlight grows strong.

rites.name: Telorastes
rites.text: A ferocious azure surge of ember-fire that a legendary ancestral dragon unleashes. It stands as one of the dragon's signature techniques, alongside its companion blaze.

rites.name: Valeonum
rites.text: A learned talent that cancels any attack carried on sound, leaving the bearer untouched as if wrapped in silence. It exists only as a shelved technique that no one ever put into practice.

rites.name: Seontus
rites.text: A swift strike of drifting wind-craft that cannot be dodged or blurred by sight-tricks. It was once passed down as a teachable art, carried between practitioners for generations.

rites.name: Teontanum
rites.text: A harmful striking technique used in combat by creatures of the wild. It was first taught to practitioners during a later era of the realm.

rites.name: Vallium Manor
rites.text: A ringing technique of rattling armor-like plates that a single creature uses as its own special craft. It is one of that creature's defining practices.

rites.name: Nosus
rites.text: A cold-natured technique bound to a single slow, thoughtful creature and its curious kin. It is a learned manner of unsettling an opponent with a frosty, quiet chill.

rites.name: Ceontium
rites.text: A swift strike technique that deals harm to foes and is taught through a training scroll. It was introduced to the wider world in a later era of the realm.

rites.name: Teones
rites.text: A reckless airborne strike in which a creature hurls itself forward on wings, taking heavy recoil damage. It mirrors a fiery charge technique used by the fire-kindred.

rites.name: Amestallia
rites.text: A chance-driven blow that finds a hidden flaw in a target's guard and deals double harm, ignoring any bonuses or penalties to strength. Certain techniques, charms, and rituals raise the odds of landing one.

rites.name: Teloliarus
rites.text: A fiery technique that is the strongest of its kind in the land. Only a fully grown fire-bonded companion can learn it, and it has two counterparts that unleash plant and water forces.

rites.name: Siantia
rites.text: A binding sealing rite that strips a chosen creature of its ability to bear or wield any carried tool or trinket. Once sealed, the bearer cannot draw upon any held item until the seal fades.

rites.name: Ceolanum Valestia
rites.text: A leaping strike delivered with a powerful foot in a fighting style. It was a favored technique of one fighter until a later era passed.

rites.name: Casianum
rites.text: A mind-based technique that lets a skilled user bend or lift unseen forces with focused thought. It is practiced by a particular kind of gifted adept.

rites.name: Oreollontus
rites.text: A chilled technique in which the practitioner rolls a frozen sphere that gathers strength with each turn. It was once the trademark craft of a line of small round creatures.

rites.name: Reolles
rites.text: A frozen-visage power held only by one peculiar creature of the cold. It lets the bearer endure a sudden blow by shedding a crusted ice shell.

rites.name: Vallaustor
rites.text: A powerful water-based technique that a fully grown partner creature can unleash. It requires a moment of rest afterward before it can be used again.

rites.name: Causium
rites.text: A chilling strike of frozen force that a fighter delivers by hand. It has been passed along through many training scrolls and can be learned from a sealed teaching stone.

rites.name: Siasor
rites.text: A learned craft that lets certain beings strengthen their blows and strikes. Nineteen kinds of creatures have this skill, and one of them can take a greater form.

rites.name: Sisaullanum
rites.text: A quiet healing craft that lets a particular kind of creature mend its own wounds and steady its nerves. It belongs to one lineage and marks its bearers as distinct.

rites.name: Menanum
rites.text: A transformative craft by which a creature changes into a new form. It is a recurring mechanic that has been part of the world since its earliest era.

rites.name: Amestiarnus
rites.text: A defensive craft possessed only by certain metal-bodied creatures of a single kind. Those who carry it bristle with hooked spines that wound those who strike them.

rites.name: Serelium
rites.text: A charming chime of sound that a speaker releases toward a foe, weakening its aggression. It is a technique of the sweet-tuned craft, learned by many practitioners in the later ages.

rites.name: Relles
rites.text: A devastating beam technique that unleashes raw energy in a single blast. It is recorded as a teachable craft passed between practitioners through numbered scrolls across several eras.

rites.name: Coresor
rites.text: A flying-type technique that scatters clouds of fog and hazy veils, letting a wielder see clearly again. It can only be learned after proving oneself against a regional trial-master.

rites.name: Rausum
rites.text: A stylized mask-technique that a fighter uses to hide weakness behind a bold front. It is taught through a numbered manual and passed between training halls across several eras.

rites.name: Telarum Serosanum
rites.text: A knack possessed by eleven creatures that keeps their keen edges from being dulled by rivals. It is passed quietly from one body to another.

rites.name: Orollarum
rites.text: A harmless tactic that compels an opponent to repeat the same action for a short span of rounds. If a silencing trick follows, the victim is left flailing with a desperate fallback until both effects fade.

rites.name: Tauseoles
rites.text: A violent, invisible current of raw energy drifts through the land and scorches whatever lies in its path. It can shift color and is sometimes channeled by machines or powerful beasts.

rites.name: Oriarnalum
rites.text: A reckoning used to measure how much harm a creature inflicts. It weighs the strength of the blow against the defenses of the one struck.

rites.name: Miallinum
rites.text: A dread-laden strike drawn from the fire of longing, sent forth by a star-spirit as its defining technique. It arrives in a hush that few can dodge or foresee.

rites.name: Coriarnanum
rites.text: A dark craft introduced in the fourth age of the realm. It belongs to a shadowy being and is its signature technique.

rites.name: Saulia
rites.text: A bristling resolve that belongs naturally to a pair of small blade-bearing creatures. Seventeen beings share this trait, including one transformed form and one regional variant.

rites.name: Narnum
rites.text: A forceful strike technique performed by a heavy metal creature, delivering two blows in quick succession. It is the creature's most characteristic attack and was first taught in a later age of its lineage.

rites.name: Telausum
rites.text: A forceful strike technique that a fighter delivers with bare hands and that is taught in a later age of training. It is accessible in every training scroll except the earliest copies.

rites.name: Nantollus
rites.text: A chilling power that lets its wielders endure bitter cold and freezing storms. They command frost at will, and their strikes can lock foes in ice until the chill loosens its grip.

rites.name: Teliasistor
rites.text: A heavy strike of a fearsome drake-like technique, first taught in a later age. It was once the trademark blow of a tall, many-headed palm-beast of the southern isles.

rites.name: Lestum
rites.text: A chilling mirrored strike shared between a veteran keeper and his loyal sea creature. The attack channels their bond into a single icy blast.

rites.name: Cintiasanum
rites.text: A quiet technique that forces a foe to adopt the same ability as its user. It does no harm, yet it reshapes the foe's capacity for battle.

rites.name: Lenaulum
rites.text: A quiet binding technique that holds a rival within a shell of sealing light. The bound foe cannot strike, though the technique itself never harms.

rites.name: Telernanum Soleonor
rites.text: A ghostly binding craft in which the user ties its own fate to a foe's. If the user falls, the bound opponent falls with it.

rites.name: Valanes
rites.text: A knack held only by one burrowing creature that lets it consume the soil beneath it. It first appeared in a later generation of its kind, giving the being a unique way to feed and move through the ground.

rites.name: Oristium
rites.text: A rare inherited gift that belongs solely to one legendary creature of the lineage. It lets its holder take on a shape and essence bound to a particular aspect of its being.

rites.name: Minium
rites.text: A quiet, evasive technique that a creature uses to cloud its own outline, so that foes find it hard to tell its true form from its copies. It is taught through a small etched disc that carries the knowledge from one creature to the next.

rites.name: Rorniases
rites.text: A leaping strike technique that launches the practitioner high into the air to deliver a powerful kick. It was once the signature art of a single lithe fighter before being set aside.

rites.name: Valorium
rites.text: A rhythmic strike technique performed by a single creature, pounding its resonant body to build force. It belongs to the thunderous fighting style of one particular beast.

rites.name: Vausia Orisaulus
rites.text: A mental technique that strikes foes with a psychic-type attack. It is the signature maneuver of a great feathered flyer from a northern realm.

rites.name: Rasaustum
rites.text: A reflective ward that answers magical strikes in kind. Whatever harm the bearer takes from sorcery is returned doubled upon the caster, and the ward always answers after the blow lands.

rites.name: Causor
rites.text: A harsh ringing technique that a creature can unleash against a foe. It is categorized as a steel-aligned method introduced in the third age of practice.

rites.name: Riasernia
rites.text: A practiced gesture that lets a creature call forth one chance-chosen technique from the whole known repertoire. The result may be a common art or a rare one tied to a specific kind of being.

rites.name: Corenteorum
rites.text: A ray of silvery lunar force that its wielder unleashes as a signature technique. Certain sky-bound beings can channel it, and a special crystal lets one transform into a stronger form that wields it.

rites.name: Costenum
rites.text: A soft, enchanting touch that lulls a foe into deep sleep. It is the signature technique of a certain frost-voiced caster.

rites.name: Orestes Serisanum
rites.text: A learnable action that a creature can acquire and use during a contest between creatures. Some of these actions can also be performed outside of such contests in the open world.

rites.name: Menallor
rites.text: A swift strike technique that a fighting creature once used as its signature move. It was first recorded in a later generation of the world's combat lore.

rites.name: Amonestor
rites.text: A breeding technique where two creatures from different linguistic origins are paired, raising the chance that their offspring shine with a rare glimmer. Matching origins keep the usual odds.

rites.name: Oriasanum
rites.text: A mental technique that is aimed at a chosen foe, granting the user an unerring sense of its next move. It belongs to the mind-shaping arts of an ancient discipline.

rites.name: Amasia Liselus
rites.text: A grounded strike aimed at an opponent's legs that deals heavy harm. It was among the earliest techniques taught to combatants in the older traditions.

rites.name: Ceosastor
rites.text: A quiet knack that lifts a bearer clear of the ground, shielding it from earth-bound harm. Many beings of differing kinds share this gift.

rites.name: Mintaustium
rites.text: A newly introduced kind of overwhelming technique that belongs to a particular elemental affinity. It was first introduced in the eighth age of the great contests.

rites.name: Valestia
rites.text: A chance-driven technique whose force shifts unpredictably each time it is invoked. It rolls among seven graded strengths, with the middle grade appearing far more often than the extremes.

rites.name: Valasteror
rites.text: A ritual maneuver performed by a winged beast of the high crags, drawing vital essence from its foes to mend its own wounds.

rites.name: Seoria
rites.text: A wild and destructive art that channels the raw fury of the land. It is the signature technique of the guardian spirits who watch over the realm.

rites.name: Oranaustium
rites.text: A forceful technique that a fighter may unleash in the arena. It was first taught to practitioners during a later age of the realm.

rites.name: Miallarnia
rites.text: A soft radiance drawn from the night sky that restores strength to a wielder. It draws on the same gentle power as the dawn's warm glow.

rites.name: Mentium
rites.text: A passive gift that lets its bearer send back hostile status effects to whoever cast them. Only a handful of beings in the world can carry this gift, and a few of them can awaken it further.

rites.name: Nasenum
rites.text: A defensive technique that arrived in a later age of practice, one of the shielding arts used to brace against incoming strikes.

rites.name: Sorium
rites.text: A common plain attuning found across the land, most of its techniques strike without a flourish. It lacks any edge against rival attunings, and a few kinds of foe are immune to it altogether.

rites.name: Amisorium
rites.text: A harmful binding technique that a single specific being is known to use. It is a learned method of attack that appeared in a later era of the world.

rites.name: Coreosum
rites.text: A bright, forceful art of the wild that is wielded by one legendary being. It draws on radiant energy and unleashes it in a single violent burst.

rites.name: Sesor Siantania
rites.text: A innate knack held only by a certain class of gentle spirit-beasts, letting them draw a soft drifting mist over the land around them. Few beings in the world possess this gift.

rites.name: Ronaulor
rites.text: A shimmering barrier technique that a caster can raise to soften the force of incoming attacks for a time. It can be taught and passed along through sealed tokens carried by travelers.

rites.name: Teloles
rites.text: A soothing technique drawn from the pale glow above, used by a certain enchanted creature to restore its allies. It is one of the signature arts of that creature's kind.

rites.name: Oristum
rites.text: A fire-natured cry used by certain beast kin. It was once the hallmark technique of a pair of lion-like creatures before it passed out of their keeping.

rites.name: Nollarnor
rites.text: A dark sleep-technique that binds a foe into unsettling dreams. It was taught through a sealed teaching stone during an early era of the land.

rites.name: Toses
rites.text: A violent surge of dragon-like rage that a serpentine line of creatures unleashes in battle. It was first recorded in an early era and can be taught through a sealed scroll of learning.

rites.name: Caustia
rites.text: A tricky attack in which the user strikes foes and scatters coins that reward its wielder with spoils. It is taught by a certain disc and was long favored by a particular clever creature.

rites.name: Cosia
rites.text: A ritual technique first recorded in a later era, performed exclusively by one large amphibious beast whose body it defines. Practitioners learn it as their singular and most celebrated art.

rites.name: Corenia Restillanum
rites.text: A guardian's protective instinct that lets a creature's young strike alongside it. The bond gives the parent an extra blow in each clash.

rites.name: Vollus Vastia
rites.text: A dreadful gale is unleashed upon a foe, shoving it back with a chilling blast. The caster may also draw strength from the storm, surging in all its abilities at once.

rites.name: Valiantesor
rites.text: A creature's final burst of power inflates its body until it covers much of the ground, pushing nearby foes aside. Once it peaks, it snaps back to its usual size and sends surrounding enemies flying.

rites.name: Cerornus
rites.text: A mind-bending technique that a trainer and her stone-like moon creature perform together. It is a coordinated move drawn from the bond between them.

rites.name: Soranum Amarnanum
rites.text: A mental technique that is passed from one mind to another through a numbered teaching stone. It has been taught in many ages, and each new teaching lets it be learned again.

rites.name: Rases
rites.text: A regal aura that keeps the bearer's allies from being distracted or hindered. It is a trait shared by a single noble kind of creature.

rites.name: Coriasium
rites.text: A fighter's strike loses force when the target's nature shields it from that element. The blow is blunted, so a strike against a foe that cannot be harmed by its kind hits weaker.

rites.name: Orarnanum
rites.text: A forceful mind-based technique that strikes an opponent with overwhelming inner energy. It is the trademark strike of a rare, otherworldly creature.

rites.name: Rornium Amarnia
rites.text: A forceful strike of stone-breaking power, introduced in an early age of the world. It once belonged to a single great beast before passing out of its keeping.

rites.name: Corauranum Amauntes
rites.text: A tricky strike technique that deals harm to an opponent and can snatch a small fruit they carry.

rites.name: Veorus Sirnauntes
rites.text: A venomous strike delivered with a lashing tail, a technique that once belonged to a single serpent-like creature before it was taught more widely.

rites.name: Mauniarnium
rites.text: A harsh striking technique whose force grows with every enhancement the victim has gathered. Its power rises in steps and tops out at a fixed ceiling.

rites.name: Seollaunum
rites.text: A harsh strike technique that answers a blow with a second blow of greater force. It is taught as a learnable skill among fighters and is recorded in the training manuals of several trade guilds.

rites.name: Telanor Teostium
rites.text: A transferred gift that a bearer may take in from another source. It works just like a known alchemical power, and it belongs only to one particular kind of creature.

rites.name: Orernistum
rites.text: A mind-linked bite technique that was once the trademark strike of a jaw-driven creature. It belongs to a later generation of combat arts and is unlike older physical attacks.

rites.name: Vellor
rites.text: A quiet technique that causes no harm but drains the rise and fall of another's strength and lays it onto the practitioner. Every boost or drop the target carries is passed along, and the user takes these changes as its own.

rites.name: Volines
rites.text: A signature technique introduced in a later age, one of two belonging to a single fierce creature. It is recorded among the arts of that being's kind.

rites.name: Valilones
rites.text: A devastating ground-shaking technique that a creature can unleash to strike with immense force. It belongs to a powerful class of finishing maneuvers that can be used only once per battle.

rites.name: Vontor
rites.text: A soft scented haze that a gentle creature releases to charm and calm nearby foes. It was once the trademark technique of one particular gentle creature, and it now belongs to the wider art of enchanting spells.

rites.name: Valanum
rites.text: A dark maneuver in which a collapsing void swallows an attack and strikes with its own crushing force. It is a special signature technique drawn from the modern era of contests.

rites.name: Santium
rites.text: A powerful signature technique that can be unleashed only once a special charge is gathered. It was first recorded in a later era of training and combat.

rites.name: Nasernes
rites.text: A reckless, high-velocity assault technique that strikes with overwhelming speed once a special bond is channeled. It is a finishing maneuver drawn from a companion's stored energy.

rites.name: Tonus
rites.text: A rare inner surge that only a select kind of otherworldly creature can awaken. When it stirs, the creature's strongest trait swells, making it dramatically more formidable in struggle.

rites.name: Senaurium
rites.text: A technique that a single small creature alone can perform. It arrived in a later age and is tied closely to that one creature.

rites.name: Lirnases
rites.text: A bond-born power that only one particular swift amphibian-like being can awaken, granted during a special gathering of its kind. It rests on a shared trust between a fighter and its companion.

rites.name: Telaneostum
rites.text: A tactic in which a chosen ally is allowed to act before its turn, so the target of the technique moves last. A quieter counterpart can instead force a rival to delay its action.

rites.name: Teolaror
rites.text: A sharp attacking technique that a creature performs by seizing its foe with its jaws. It began as a different kind of strike and was later reclassified into a darker form of combat.

rites.name: Cenia
rites.text: A craft shared by a single bird-like creature, letting it bring out a companion trait of its own kind. It belongs to one lineage alone and has only recently appeared in the records.

rites.name: Viales
rites.text: A dark-aspected technique that a companion creature may perform in battle. It is one of the signature maneuvers tied to a particular partner beast.

rites.name: Amintum
rites.text: A raw, borrowed force that a wielder draws into themselves to bolster their strength. It is a craft tied to the cold, shimmering currents of the sky.

rites.name: Vianeorum
rites.text: A reflexive trait that lets a certain beast-kind later bring back and chew over a meal it has already swallowed. It is one of two traits found only in that creature.

rites.name: Oriseonanum
rites.text: A signature technique of a colossal guardian in its fullest form. It belongs to a particular elemental affinity and was first recorded in a later era of the world.

rites.name: Nilentes
rites.text: A bonded fire-technique shared by a trainer and their companion creature, unleashed together for a blazing, all-consuming assault. It is performed by a specific pair who have mastered its heat.

rites.name: Amernor
rites.text: A forceful strike of stone energy that a particular wolf-like creature in its daytime and evening aspect uses as its defining technique. It was introduced in a comparatively recent era of its kind.

rites.name: Nastiasor
rites.text: A charged striking technique introduced in the newest era of combat arts. It serves as the defining method of two lightning-linked beasts.

rites.name: Veornum
rites.text: A devastating, fighting-style power that a trainer unleashes once a special charged gesture has been struck. It is a finishing blow that delivers force to an opponent.

rites.name: Telauresium
rites.text: A power granted only to one particular creature, awakened in its later generation of existence. It lets the bearer shatter a hidden barrier of energy surrounding it.

rites.name: Ameonelanum
rites.text: A fluid technique that strikes with rushing current and wave-footwork. It is the signature art of a rain-dancing creature.

rites.name: Mosia
rites.text: A rare inherent gift granted only to a select class of mighty transformed beings. Two such beings are known to wield it.

rites.name: Tallauntus
rites.text: A quiet technique that lets a user swap places in the minds of its allies, altering who stands where in the moment. It deals no harm and was devised in a later era of learning.

rites.name: Liasontium
rites.text: A paired technique in which a bonded creature and its companion unleash a shimmering watery strike. It is shared between a trainer and her powerful amphibious partner.

rites.name: Varnorium
rites.text: A fiery strike technique unique to one particular winged creature, in which it gathers heat and hurls it forward through its hard beak. It is that creature's most characteristic and signature attack.

rites.name: Coraseones
rites.text: A unified bond that lets a single being act as two forces at once. Its power is drawn from a rider joined to the one who wields it.

rites.name: Cianus
rites.text: A soft, charming technique that a small line of creatures uses as its own signature art. It was taught to students through a special training disc.

rites.name: Seriarnus
rites.text: A fiery technique of the same family as its kind, drawn from resentment. It is a strike that burns those who hold a grudge.

rites.name: Corentor
rites.text: A craft tied to a single bearer, letting one person call up a set of small glowing tokens that spill outward from their hands. The skill belongs only to that one individual and no one else.

rites.name: Milleoranum
rites.text: A ritual technique of ringing resonance that a scaled armored beast channels into a single devastating surge. It belongs uniquely to one creature and is unlocked only when its bearer gathers a special charm.

rites.name: Mauseornium
rites.text: A defensive technique that shields its user while spreading a venomous chill to any foe who strikes at it. It belongs to a single creature known for its hardened, many-plated carapace.

rites.name: Orisia
rites.text: A learned trick that lets one creature retrieve a thrown sphere and bring it back to its companion. Only a single kind of creature is able to perform this skill.

rites.name: Ameornor
rites.text: A devastating strike wielded by a legendary sword-bearing beast, mirrored by two rival titans' heavy assaults. It is the signature technique of its wielder and answers the other great blows of its kind.

rites.name: Narillanum
rites.text: A dormant inner fury that a select few creatures can awaken, each sharing this trait with three beings. Only one of them can be transformed into a stronger form.

rites.name: Sauntelum
rites.text: A ritual technique of crackling lightning drawn from a wielder's bond with a small loyal creature. It is a single devastating strike unique to one particular partnership.

rites.name: Ventus
rites.text: A shifting technique that reshapes a user's own nature to match an opponent's defensive quality. It is a signature art of one line of synthetic beings.

rites.name: Montiastus
rites.text: A forceful, sharp-edged technique that hits hard and quickly. It belongs to the family of attacks that deal harm through speed and impact.

rites.name: Valiarus
rites.text: A bewitching dark wave is a coordinated strike unleashed by a trainer and their beast together. It is performed in close bond between the caster and their hound-like companion.

rites.name: Viantus
rites.text: A soft fluffy cloud of pale tufts gathers around a creature when it is struck. The cloud drops the speed of anything that is near it.

rites.name: Telornaurum
rites.text: A traveler bonds a chosen creature as a walking companion. Each stretch of journey on foot yields a measure of the creature's special essence.

rites.name: Nauntium
rites.text: A corrosive storm of tainted rain falls in a single sudden burst, eating into whatever it touches. It is unleashed as a one-time, specially charged strike by those who have gathered the energy for it.

rites.name: Sereorus
rites.text: A carefully timed technique that reshapes its user's nature to match a chosen form. It is the defining craft of one lineage of artificial beings.

rites.name: Seriasillor
rites.text: A battle strategy in which a practitioner gathers two kinds of raw force and uses them to strip an opponent's reserves until their lights go dim.

rites.name: Veostanor
rites.text: A lingering acidic power that lets certain serpentine beings dissolve and eat away at other things. Only a few related creatures are known to possess this gift.

rites.name: Orausia
rites.text: A forceful technique that a legendary guardian beast unleashes in battle. It is the signature strike of a single revered creature.

rites.name: Listeoles
rites.text: A blunt strike that disregards any hardening or dodging the target has built up. It lands as if the defender had never shielded itself at all.

rites.name: Verirnanum
rites.text: A resonant technique where a healer and her gentle beast join their voices in one joyous, amplified cry. It is the bonded pairing's signature shared art.

rites.name: Teontases
rites.text: A forceful strike of the flame-element kind, unleashed by a single bearer of an iron-clad form. It is the defining technique of that creature.

rites.name: Cinor
rites.text: A violent gust of wind that a legendary creature unleashes in combat. It is the signature attack of a storm-bearing beast.

rites.name: Menontor
rites.text: A signature surge technique bound to one small electric creature, unleashed through a charged crystal of its own. It channels a thunderous burst of lightning that only that creature can call forth.

rites.name: Orerium
rites.text: A crackling lattice of charged threads that strikes foes with lightning. It belongs to the spider-like creatures that weave and bind with it.

rites.name: Nintus
rites.text: A coiled strike technique that hurls an opponent away with a sweeping blow. It belongs to the draconic style of combat and was introduced in the fifth era of practice.

rites.name: Oriastes Valirnausor
rites.text: A fiery technique that a single fire-bearing creature of a particular species uses as its signature attack. It belongs to a newer generation of combat arts.

rites.name: Tostaunor
rites.text: A devastating energy discharge wielded by an ancient colossal entity. It is the most forceful strike of its draconic lineage, surpassed only by specially prepared and ceremonial techniques.

rites.name: Tilum
rites.text: A crackling charge spreads across the ground, empowering lightning-aligned forces within its reach. It is a technique introduced in a later age of the land's learning.

rites.name: Calliarnium
rites.text: A harmful technique where a fighter submerges beneath the surface to strike an opponent. Its use beyond combat requires a certain guild's recognition, and it can be used to explore sunken ruins.

rites.name: Corolisia
rites.text: A devastating aerial strike technique, unleashed as a single powerful assault that belongs to the Generation VII arsenal. It channels a bond with a fierce draconic spirit.

rites.name: Miastelor
rites.text: A rare growth state that only one singular ancient creature can enter, swelling its body enormously and altering its look. It cannot be triggered by ordinary means, appearing briefly only during one special blast.

rites.name: Nalium
rites.text: A learned technique passed down among the wise keepers of the cloud forests. It belongs to a single revered forest scholar who alone can perform it.

rites.name: Tistiares
rites.text: A chilling blow of frozen force, favored by a single armored sea-crusher. It is a strike of cold power that its wielder uses as its defining technique.

rites.name: Veolosus
rites.text: A coordinated aerial strike performed by a pilot and her winged mount together. It is a shared technique that lets the rider and companion attack in perfect unison.

rites.name: Rirasum
rites.text: A creature can briefly swell to towering size for three turns using a worn band, once per clash. Its strikes transform into overwhelming forms that can weaken foes or alter the surrounding skies.

rites.name: Sentium
rites.text: A forceful technique that drains a rival's vitality until it matches the user's own strength. It is a combat art that appeared in a later age of training.

rites.name: Lorisium
rites.text: A dual-charge technique of crackling force that a particular wild creature unleashes as its signature strike. It is first taught to the creature's kind in a recent era of the world.

rites.name: Orolia
rites.text: A spinning, boring technique used by a pair of burrowing creatures to strike with great force. It is the signature strike of those two beings.

rites.name: Sialosium
rites.text: A swift strike of rushing air that lands two quick blows in succession. It is a close-range technique used by winged fighters to unsettle their foes.

rites.name: Leornilanum
rites.text: A innate knack that only storm-blooded creatures carry, letting them crackle with charge. Few beings possess it, and one rare form of a creature awakens it fully.

rites.name: Naurnia
rites.text: A tide-wrought technique in which heated vapor and rushing water combine into a single forceful blow. It belongs to a wandering, ancient-seeming creature that moves like a surging sea.

rites.name: Sauntus
rites.text: A dark drifting hex that clings to a creature of one particular nature, giving it a power that works upon the foes it faces. It belongs only to beings of that single kin and was first seen in a later age of the world.

rites.name: Ciania
rites.text: A borrowed ability that only one particular creature species can carry. When its bearer is badly hurt, it immediately withdraws from the fight, mirroring a sister technique.

rites.name: Nalium Valiarnus
rites.text: A rising current of charged power that is found only within one kind of serpentine water creature. It was first recorded in a later age of the world and lifts its bearer upward.

rites.name: Tiasales
rites.text: A stylized technique that is the defining skill of a certain creature, marking a new era of its kind. It belongs to a recent generation of such practices.

rites.name: Lonium
rites.text: A ritual surge of blazing heat that a bearer can unleash once a charged sigil has been awakened. It arrives as a newer discipline among practitioners of the flame arts.

rites.name: Teliranum
rites.text: A quiet knack that lets certain creatures slip past defenses and barriers others would hold. Only a few kinds of beings were born with it, and a larger number learned it later.

rites.name: Sesor
rites.text: A tactic that lets a creature turn its hidden insides outward in response to attacks. Two creatures of its kind can carry this trait, and one of them can transform into a stronger form.

rites.name: Ristum
rites.text: A craft of bending one's outward appearance so that observers mistake the bearer for something harmless. It is practised only by one kind of small cloaked creature, which always wears the trait.

rites.name: Cauniastus
rites.text: A chilling strike of frozen flame that a great winter beast unleashes. It is the signature attack of a legendary frost creature.

rites.name: Tesus
rites.text: A raw, fiery force that a single towering wyrm-like being can draw upon in combat. It is that being's defining technique and cannot be wielded by anyone else.

rites.name: Raullornum
rites.text: A charged strike drawn from the storm-touched arts, wielded by a single creature of the wild. It is the defining technique of that creature, flashing with crackling energy.

rites.name: Mireollor
rites.text: A dark-aligned technique of the modern era, a cord-throw maneuver tied to a fiery beast. It is the signature strike of that creature.

rites.name: Cornia
rites.text: A radiant technique drawn from a sparkling, charming force that is used in battle. It is taught to practitioners through a readable tutoring disc that passes the skill along.

rites.name: Reonastum
rites.text: A learned knack that lets a creature sharpen its strikes. Four of its kind are known to carry this gift.

rites.name: Talor
rites.text: A dormant power that lets a creature scorch the skies into a blazing dry heat. Five beings carry it, and one of them has awakened a greater form.

rites.name: Seriantanum
rites.text: A devastating aerial strike that only creatures of the serpent kind can wield. Any such beast may master it once its bond with its keeper is fully grown.

rites.name: Seraneostia
rites.text: A soothing practice that draws on the living growth of the wild woods to restore wounded allies. It is the signature technique of a particular forest-dwelling wanderer.

rites.name: Virnium
rites.text: A technique in which two attacks merge when they meet, or a creature strikes right after a companion's blow. Some are wholly new strikes that spring from nothing else.

rites.name: Tontirnum
rites.text: A chilling ability that a certain line of winged moth-like beings possesses. It is found only within that single lineage of creatures.

rites.name: Mintolles
rites.text: A transformative power that only one kind of creature can wield, first awakened in a later age of wanderers. It lets its bearer change its nature through a surge of stored lightning.

rites.name: Nileostium
rites.text: A charged technique that forces an incoming attack to carry a current of energy. It is the signature art of two small sun-tended creatures.

rites.name: Tistes
rites.text: A gentle bond technique where two willing companions link their grips, letting a shared feeling pass between them. It is granted only through a special gathering and cannot be learned through ordinary training.

rites.name: Taurnium
rites.text: A devastating sealed technique that a small, fox-like creature unleashes in a single burst. It draws on a special charge built up earlier and belongs to that creature alone.

rites.name: Vintum
rites.text: A powerful water-aspected technique that can be unleashed only once per struggle. It was first taught to the wider realm during a later era of its history.

rites.name: Tentaunes
rites.text: A chilling incantation that a single unusual sage-creature wields as its own trademark art. It drains the strength from foes who hear its warbling tones.

rites.name: Testarus
rites.text: A mental-energy technique that bursts outward across a crowded field. It is classed as a psychic-style action introduced in a later era of training.

rites.name: Orosiastia
rites.text: A swift water-kind technique introduced in a later era, belonging to a single amphibious guardian creature. It delivers a rapid, forceful blow that defines that creature's fighting style.

rites.name: Tosistia
rites.text: A transformation power granted only to one towering reptilian form, wakened in a later age of the world. It lets that great beast surge into a greater shape than it normally holds.

rites.name: Ronillia
rites.text: A defensive technique that a single guardian creature can call upon to hold firm against incoming harm. Only one particular creature is able to wield it.

rites.name: Teostes
rites.text: A sound-based technique that can be taught to a creature through a sealed disc. It is a voice-type skill added in a later age of the world.

rites.name: Vausum
rites.text: A branching underground network power shared by a pair of fungal-kin beings, letting them draw strength through hidden threads that run beneath the soil.

rites.name: Virium Rantes
rites.text: A frosty cooperative technique performed by a commander and a crystalline creature acting in unison. It is the signature joint maneuver shared between that pair.

rites.name: Ceranum
rites.text: A power that belongs only to one enlarged creature form, introduced in a later age of its world. It draws strength from the light of the sky to enhance the being that wields it.

rites.name: Orausia Rireostium
rites.text: A coin-scattering technique that marks a gleaming, wealth-bearing being, performed as its signature skill. It rains glittering currency upon foes in a sudden, showy burst.

rites.name: Amiarnelia
rites.text: A knack granted only to a certain attuned creature kind, arriving in a later era of the world. Three beings bear this knack, and one of them can transform into a greater form.

rites.name: Senilum
rites.text: A fiery technique that a sealed fox-like creature once performed as its signature. Later the creature stopped being bound to it, but the technique still exists as a charm of fire and allure.

rites.name: Teleonostia
rites.text: A crude technique in which a fighter hurls wet earth at a rival to lower their accuracy. Its use spread through the combat schools of a later generation of contestants.

rites.name: Taustium
rites.text: A bonded creature can unleash a swirling storm of its wind-element technique once it has swelled to colossal size. It is only available to those who already know how to command that element.

rites.name: Teonentia
rites.text: A delayed water-bubble strike that a wielder and their paired aquatic beast unleash together. It hurls a cluster of shimmering spheres at a foe.

rites.name: Sastialium
rites.text: A dark-typed technique unveiled in the ninth cycle of contests. It belongs to a shifting creature in its greatest transformed state and temporarily takes the place of another assault.

rites.name: Ciantus
rites.text: A radiant technique belonging to a gentle flower-spirit, drawn from the fairy arts and known for its devastating glow. It is the defining move of a rarely seen guardian of blossoms.

rites.name: Rintia
rites.text: A gift held only by a select kind of creature that lightens its body. Those who possess it are a bit more fragile than others of their kind.

rites.name: Saraunus
rites.text: A calming vapor that only certain creatures in one bloodline can exude. It belongs to that line alone and is passed through its evolutions.

rites.name: Corontasia
rites.text: A hidden trait that belongs only to one creature's evolutionary family. It works the same way as another trait known as Mirrorwake, letting the holder change its nature to match whatever it faces.

rites.name: Taurentium
rites.text: A bright, striking technique of a single kind, first recorded in the newest generation of the tradition. It is the defining maneuver of one particular creature, which relies on it above all others.

rites.name: Mianores
rites.text: A borrowed-shape craft held only by one kind of cold-water creature, letting it take on the look of its surroundings. The skill appeared in a later era of the world's lineage.

rites.name: Amaulenor
rites.text: A tongue-based technique that has a moderate chance to leave its target unable to move. It is one of the earliest techniques of its kind.

rites.name: Nialor
rites.text: A harsh, sweeping technique that a fighter can unleash once a newer era of practice has taken hold. It draws on a particular elemental current and makes its user's assault far more forceful.

rites.name: Amenor
rites.text: A plain technique that a creature can use, first taught to the world in a later age of training. Its exact nature is not described here.

rites.name: Veorium Ciarium
rites.text: A powerful bright strike technique that a creature can unleash in a single decisive burst. It belongs to a rarer class of combat art taught to those who master the modern battle style.

rites.name: Cialentanum
rites.text: A devastating ritual technique unlocked by a charged token, which a small cloaked creature uses to transform a gentle rough strike into a surge of overwhelming power.

rites.name: Tontum
rites.text: A dark strike technique that belongs to one particular armored creature. It was first taught to the people of a newer age and marks that creature's signature attack.

rites.name: Ameoria
rites.text: A hidden gift that lets a certain line of small water-sprites turn their calls into flowing sound. It exists only within that bloodline of creatures.

rites.name: Vistus
rites.text: A coordinated strike of shifting elemental force, unlocked by a single guardian creature. It was introduced in a later era of the world's craft and belongs to that guardian alone.

rites.name: Vilium
rites.text: A woman wakes alone in the night and voices her private longings through a quiet melody. Gentle creatures drift nearby as she sings.

rites.name: Ceranum Rasilium
rites.text: A mind-bending rite that a seer and her night-gazing bird perform together, unleashing a sharp surge of hidden power. It belongs to one trainer's partnered bond.

rites.name: Coriallirum
rites.text: A restorative technique that a pair of gentle beasts can perform to mend their own wounds. It is a signature practice of one of them and matches two other healing arts exactly.

rites.name: Orestallium
rites.text: A devastating aerial technique of the fire-kin, unlocked when a bonded beast channels its stored power into one reckless leaping strike. Only one particular creature masters it.

rites.name: Ciaror Tilus
rites.text: A fierce striking technique of the elemental fighting kind, first taught in a later age of the world. It is the trademark strike of a single wandering warrior-bird who wields a leek-like staff.

rites.name: Viasanum Tentor
rites.text: A sacrificial technique in which the wielder collapses into unconsciousness, and in return the foe's striking and spellcasting strength is sharply diminished.

rites.name: Calles
rites.text: A quality that only the mythic dragon-kin can wield, it lets a creature of this kind reduce incoming harm when its health is full. Three of these beings possess it, and one is able to transform into a greater shape.

rites.name: Leontor
rites.text: A perceptive power that lets one specific brute of the wild pierce illusions and see through deceptions. It belongs solely to a single moon-touched beast of the newer era.

rites.name: Lontus
rites.text: A powerful signature technique that a creature can unleash in a special overpowering form. It was first recorded in the eighth age of the lineage's training records.

rites.name: Orirnus
rites.text: A gust-borne technique that a combatant unleashes in a towering surge of power. It arrives as a newer form of wide-reaching assault.

rites.name: Ameostaunor
rites.text: A tactic in which a bearer hurls a stored offering whose strength and form depend on the kind of charm it holds. The power changes with each carried token.

rites.name: Sesorium
rites.text: A lasting scent that clings to one particular kind of creature long after it has passed by. It belongs only to males of a single species.

rites.name: Vaulesus
rites.text: A soft green technique that a living plant uses to hurl gentle, unerring blossoms at a target. It cannot be dodged and never misses.

rites.name: Nauses
rites.text: A devastating ritual technique bound to a pair of celestial beings, unleashed through a charged surge of gathered force. It is the signature art of those two lunar guardians.

rites.name: Cesia Cesus
rites.text: A grim trait that lets two sea-dwelling creatures strike harder against foes already suffering from poison. Only these two kinds of creature possess it.

rites.name: Nores
rites.text: A dangerous kind of technique that a single crystalline creature uses to strike its foes. It belongs to the newest era of its world and is the defining maneuver of that creature.

rites.name: Seriantes Caulus
rites.text: A sharp, icy-fighting technique introduced in a later era. It was once the signature technique of a particular agile warrior-creature before the rules changed.

rites.name: Vontiasium
rites.text: A volatile technique that a single strange creature uses to unleash a sudden, explosive burst of force. Its use is said to be tied to the creature's own mind.

rites.name: Amaustanum
rites.text: A powered-up technique that a being can unleash during a surge of enlargement, replacing its ordinary strikes with a stronger form. A rarer, more potent variant of it also exists.

rites.name: Oraurnum Telaules
rites.text: A harmless gesture that lets its user strike harder on the next turn. In later eras it can also mirror an opponent's technique, but only when the user moves before them.

rites.name: Rinaurnium
rites.text: A bold combat technique that a certain fighter performs to commit fully to the battle and never withdraw. It was first recorded in a later era of the world's conflicts.

rites.name: Cirestum
rites.text: A binding technique that gives a wrapping hold to a creature of the same kind of nature. It is the trademark maneuver of a clinging, many-limbed grappler.

rites.name: Amausanum
rites.text: A soft, tinted haze that can be drawn around the bearer, granted only to a pair of swift, fire-maned steeds. It belongs to a newer age of the creatures' lineage.

rites.name: Cires Tiarnia
rites.text: A charged maneuver that a certain volatile creature unleashes in battle. It is the trademark technique of its kind and belongs to a later era of the wider order.

rites.name: Reollus Lernor
rites.text: A dazzling, sea-borne flourish of song that a marine performer unleashes once its bond with a special charm is awakened. It is tied to one particular water-singing creature.

rites.name: Maria
rites.text: A knack that belongs only to one particular creature kind, granted to it in a later age of the world. It lets the bearer seize chances as they arise.

rites.name: Vantes
rites.text: A deliberate technique that a creature uses to block a foe's path or advance. It belongs to a single creature's signature repertoire and is a dark-natured technique from a recent era.

rites.name: Laurasus
rites.text: A gentle technique in which a storm of soft blossoms is loosed upon foes. It is a grass-aligned art first recorded in the sixth age of the realm.

rites.name: Rerium Rintestum
rites.text: A tidal burst of attuned force that a sea-born guardian unleashes. It is recorded as a signature technique of that guardian.

rites.name: Tiarnor
rites.text: A fiery technique introduced in a later age of the realm. It is one of the signature arts of a swift, ember-footed beast.

rites.name: Sentarus
rites.text: A venom-borne craft that lets a single wielder move afflicted targets as if by invisible strings. It belongs only to one sly, mask-wearing being of the newest age.

rites.name: Caulles
rites.text: A rare inner power lets a person merge with or become a great creature of legend. Those who bear it carry a glowing gem at the heart of their gift and use it to resist a ruthless secret cabal.

rites.name: Raurnum
